mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATCH_FILE ( FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, USE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{atchFileGrpid}, #{orgnlFileNm}, #{physFileNm}, #{filePath}, #{fileSz}, #{fileExt}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, USE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, USE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE ATCH_FILE_GRPID = #{atchFileGrpid} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY REG_DT ASC

SELECT FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, USE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
AND (ATCH_FILE_GRPID LIKE 'MP_%' OR (ATCH_FILE_GRPID NOT LIKE 'TUS_%' AND ATCH_FILE_GRPID NOT LIKE 'OTHER_%'))
AND ATCH_FILE_GRPID LIKE 'TUS_%'
AND ATCH_FILE_GRPID LIKE 'OTHER_%'
ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
SELECT FILE_GROUP_ID, CONCAT(FILE_ID, '.', FILE_KND) AS FILE_ID, FILE_NM, FILE_MG, FILE_KND, FILE_COURS FROM "GTEMS".TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE 1=1 AND FILE_ID = #{ fileId }
SELECT FILE_GROUP_ID , CONCAT(FILE_ID, '.', FILE_KND) AS FILE_ID , FILE_NM , FILE_MG , FILE_KND , FILE_COURS FROM TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE 1=1 AND FILE_GROUP_ID = #{ fileId }
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM "GTEMS".TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE 1=1 AND FILE_GROUP_ID = #{ fileGroupId }
DELETE FROM "GTEMS".TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE 1=1 AND FILE_ID = #{ fileId }
DELETE FROM "GTEMS".TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE 1=1 AND FILE_GROUP_ID = #{ groupId }
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_GROUP_ID , FILE_ID AS fileNm , FILE_NM AS fileId , FILE_ORDR , FILE_COURS AS flpth , FILE_MG , file_knd , 'R' AS CRUD , DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REGIST_DT FROM "GTEMS".TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE FILE_GROUP_ID = #{ fileId }
SELECT FILE_NM FROM TS_ATCHMNFL WHERE 1=1 AND FILE_ID = #{ fileId }
